title: The text API learned to speak
summary:
The text API learned to speak, model routing got tidier, and community projects made Pollinations easier to use in other tools.

Audio generation joined the text API through `openai-audio`, with selectable voices and audio formats. Streaming defaults to PCM16; non-streaming requests default to MP3. The docs now cover audio generation and list 19 supported voices.

Phi-4 Multimodal Instruct joined chat as `phi`. Several chat models moved to Portkey routing while keeping their model-specific prompts, and the separate Cloudflare text client was removed. Claude 3.5 Haiku also changed from `claude-hybridspace` to `claude`, so callers using the old name need to update it.

Chat requests now forward `tools` and `tool_choice` instead of dropping them. Search gained more consistent tool handling: calls run sequentially, follow-up requests preserve options such as response format, and time-sensitive searches can use the current date when no system message is supplied.

The community-built ComfyUI-Pollinations node joined the SDK and libraries lists, bringing prompt-based image and text generation into ComfyUI. A Chinese-language tutorial on adding Pollinations image generation to a DeepSeek chat UI joined the tutorials.
